sources.name: Natural Earth 10m rivers and lake centerlines
Natural Earth 10m rivers, North America supplement

provenance.licence: All versions of Natural Earth raster + vector map data found on this website are in the public domain.
provenance.edgeRule: one passable movement edge per undirected geographic adjacency edge (shared boundary segment; corner-only contacts excluded)
provenance.crossingRule: shared boundary = segments owned by both counties; pieces no longer than the tolerance count toward a river when their midpoint is within 0.02 degrees of the river's Natural Earth lines; tag the river with the highest length fraction when it is >= 0.5
provenance.riverAssumption: river courses treated as stable since 1942; centerlines only, reservoirs ignored

sanity.note: informational, not a pass/fail check: state-border river stretches are not internal edges, so internal tags on these rivers are listed for review
